propositions: Local git call sites across rebar (_commands/compact, delete, fsck, txn and _store/event_append) contend on shared git lock files (.git/index.lock, HEAD.lock, packed-refs.lock) under high concurrent local use with no built-in retry or backoff mechanism, surfacing errors to agents instead of absorbing transient conflicts

Rebar must handle local git lock contention automatically with no escalation: a per-store advisory lock plus bounded jittered retry/backoff on git call sites, silent recovery of transient conflicts, and one actionable error only when a genuinely stuck lock exhausts the bounded timeout budget

Bounded watchdog timeouts (120s for local plumbing, 300s for metrics walks) must distinguish wedged filesystems from legitimate slowness without aborting mid-write, and ref-lock retry signatures must extend from index.lock-only to cover 'cannot lock ref' and *.lock File exists patterns
Jittered contention sleeps (uniform [0.75,1.25] multiplier on each backoff) de-synchronize competing processes per git lockfile.c precedent, reducing thundering herd under high agent counts
